DNK35895 is a specific laboratory test code used within the Danish healthcare system to identify measurements of [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]]. It serves as a critical data point for tracking and evaluating the quality of care for patients with atrial fibrillation. Specifically, DNK35895 is recognized as one of the valid laboratory codes that count toward the fulfillment of clinical quality indicator 3, which mandates TSH measurement as part of the diagnostic workup for these patients [^src1]. 

The code appears in national clinical quality reports published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP). In the 2024 iteration of the "Atrieflimren i Danmark" (Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark) report, DNK35895 is listed among a specific set of codes used to define the numerator for the TSH measurement indicator [^src1]. The code continues to be utilized in the subsequent 2025 report, where it is again cataloged alongside other laboratory and procedural codes required for monitoring treatment quality, echocardiography, and anticoagulation therapy in atrial fibrillation patients [^src2]. By standardizing how TSH tests are recorded in health registries, DNK35895 ensures that healthcare providers and administrators can accurately measure compliance with evidence-based clinical guidelines.
